statement: Contre-indiquee en cas d'hypersensibilite aux Asteracees (Composees).

source.title: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
source.quote: Hypersensitivity to the active substance and to other plants of the Asteraceae (Compositae) family.

statement: Interactions via le CYP450 rapportees uniquement chez les transplantes renaux sous fortes doses prolongees (voie orale).

source.title: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
source.quote: For patients after renal transplantation taking high dosages for longer periods (about two months) interactions based on effects on CYP450 have been reported.

statement: Aucune interaction rapportee pour les voies cutanee, oromuqueuse, inhalation et bain.

source.title: EU herbal monograph on Matricaria recutita L., flos (EMA/HMPC)
source.quote: Cutaneous, oromucosal use, inhalation, or as bath additive: None reported.

statement: Pour les preparations autres que la forme a), la securite pendant la grossesse et l'allaitement n'est pas etablie.
